summary: European leaders, including the President of the European Commission, have arrived in Kyiv for a summit regarding Ukraine and Southeast Europe. Simultaneously, Ukraine reports significant maritime successes, striking 20 vessels in the Black Sea overnight. Aerial threats remain high, with reports of ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv and various drone incursions across multiple regions.
key_points: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and presidents from Serbia and Moldova arrived in Kyiv for a summit (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng).
Ukrainian forces struck 20 vessels in the Black Sea overnight, including 17 oil tankers, 2 gas tankers, and 1 tugboat (Source: @UkraineNow/82656).
President Zelenskyy announced that Ukraine is producing 10 million drones annually, with plans to double this figure (Source: @UkraineNow/82666).
A drone attack on a gas station in Malin may have been controlled via repeaters located in Belarus (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31643).
The EU has extended temporary protection for Ukrainian refugees until March 4, 2028, contingent on military service compliance (Source: @UkraineNow/82662).
Russian forces are reportedly planning false flag provocations against a NATO member using Ukrainian drones (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31654).
The US Senate has published a watered-down anti-Russian sanctions bill proposing reduced tariffs on oil and gas (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31623).
A strike in the Kryvyi Rih/Zhovti Vody area resulted in casualties, including a 13-year-old boy and a 69-year-old woman (Source: @UkraineNow/82664).

sections.executive_summary: High-level diplomatic engagement is occurring in Kyiv with the arrival of EU and Southeast European leaders. On the operational front, Ukraine has achieved significant maritime success by striking 20 vessels in the Black Sea. Meanwhile, aerial threats persist with ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv and widespread drone activity.

points: President Zelenskyy stated that Ukraine currently produces 10 million drones per year and aims to double this capacity through international partnerships (Source: @UkraineNow/82666).
Ukrainian military forces successfully struck 20 vessels in the Black Sea, including 17 oil tankers, 2 gas tankers, and 1 tugboat (Source: @UkraineNow/82656).
The EU has extended temporary protection for Ukrainian refugees until March 4, 2028, with new requirements regarding military service obligations (Source: @UkraineNow/82662).
President Zelenskyy announced plans to replace ambassadors to the United States and several other countries (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31654).
Russian officials have commented on the recent attack in Monaco, with Maria Zakharova addressing claims regarding the Ukrainian regime (Source: @tass_agency/385441).
Russian military personnel from Russia and Myanmar conducted a joint demonstration of special forces skills (Source: @tass_agency/385447).
Diplomatic sources indicate EU ambassadors have postponed negotiations regarding a 21st package of sanctions against Russia until next week (Source: @tass_agency/385440).
Russian forces launched repeated strikes using KAB glide bombs targeting the Donetsk region and the northeastern Kharkiv region (Source: @kpszsu/68628).
Reactive UAVs were reported moving towards Nizhyn in the Chernihiv region (Source: @kpszsu/68604).
Reactive UAVs were detected moving towards Kozelets and past Ripky in the Chernihiv region (Source: @eRadarrua/101207).
UAVs were reported in the Sumy region from the north and the Novgorod-Seversky district of Chernihiv (Source: @kpszsu/68641).
The 'Bandrole' loitering munition was reported heading towards Chornomorske and Lymanka from the Black Sea (Source: @kpszsu/68643; @kpszsu/68650).
Tactical aviation activity was reported in the south, posing a threat of aerial strikes (Source: @kpszsu/68597).
Ballistic missile threats were reported for Kyiv, with reports of two ballistic missiles falling on the city (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69001; @mon1tor_ua/69011).
Russian Tu-22M3 bombers are expected to conduct night strikes, with previous strikes reported against Odesa (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68986; @mon1tor_ua/69017).
Reactive UAVs were reported moving towards Kryvyi Rih and Zhovti Vody from Solone (Source: @eRadarrua/101226).
A warehouse fire was reported in Kyiv, with residents noting heavy black smoke (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31651).
The threat of ballistic weaponry remains active (Source: @kpszsu/68607).

key_developments: Ukrainian forces struck 20 vessels in the Black Sea, including 17 oil tankers and 2 gas tankers (Source: @UkraineNow/82656).
EU leaders, including the European Commission President, arrived in Kyiv for a summit (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31630).
Ukraine is producing 10 million drones annually with plans to double this output (Source: @UkraineNow/82666).
Ballistic missile strikes were reported hitting Kyiv (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69001).
The EU extended refugee protection for Ukrainians until March 2028 (Source: @UkraineNow/82662).

sections.threat_assessment: The threat environment is characterized by high-frequency aerial strikes, including ballistic missiles and reactive UAVs. The use of repeaters in Belarus for drone control suggests sophisticated electronic warfare/navigation challenges. The risk of false flag operations against NATO members remains a noted concern for regional stability.
sections.regional_response: Diplomatic efforts are ongoing, though the EU has postponed the 21st sanctions package. In Kyiv, high-level summits are being held to strengthen ties between Ukraine and Southeastern Europe. The extension of refugee protection status indicates a long-term commitment to Ukrainian citizens by the EU.
sections.intelligence_notes: The shift in Russian strike tactics toward reactive UAVs and glide bombs (KAB) indicates a change in operational approach. The ability of Ukraine to strike 20 vessels in the Black Sea demonstrates significant maritime capability. Technical delays in ballistic missile warnings are attributed to the short flight time to Kyiv.
